name: 37898-sharedprefix-4b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=10, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, safety_seconds 1800.
workload: shared-prefix repetition, single turn, text only: 20 distinct prefixes of 6000 tokens, each request one of those prefixes followed by a 2000-token request-unique body, generating exactly 100 tokens; 300 requests bounded, greedy (temperature 0.0), all lengths fixed rather than sampled.
purpose: A 4B-parameter document analysis assistant answering 8000-token queries over twenty shared templates, ten concurrent users, one GPU.
launch:
# 37898-sharedprefix-4b-1gpu -- the launch config, in `vllm serve --config` form.
# Every other engine argument is left at this engine's own default for this device, and no
# environment variable belongs to this item.

model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 8192
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
enable-prefix-caching: true
enable-chunked-prefill: true
